about.title: About
about.heading: Hello, I'm Mihaylo.
about.text: For five years I've been photographing love stories and celebrations. I tell them as they unfold, then add a few carefully composed, moody portraits. I love the energy of a wedding day, and I want every moment, big or small, to stay just as it was.
about.more: I work quietly and stay close to the day: the getting ready, the ceremony, the party. I only step in when it helps, and we always talk beforehand about what matters to you. Beyond weddings I shoot christenings, couple sessions, concerts and sports. The pace is faster, but the goal is the same: to keep what it felt like to be there.
about.outside: Put the camera down and I'm usually outside. Ski touring when there's snow, mountain biking when there isn't, and the rest of the time with friends, whether that's a beer, a slackline or just a good laugh. All those hours outdoors taught me how to read light, and they're why rain, mud or a freezing morning don't throw me off.
